user.title: Set up Ladekrone
user.description: Finds the cheapest ad-hoc charging price within the selected area. Data source: operators' AFIR reports via the German Mobilithek.

data_description.location: Set centre and radius (max. 50 km) on the map.
data_description.tariff: Ad hoc always applies. A contract or subscription price is used only where the operator publishes that tariff. Otherwise the price stays the ad-hoc price and is labelled as such.
data_description.charge_kwh: Optional, in kWh. Stations are then ranked by what this charge costs: energy, session fee and time fee (charging time estimated from the charge point's power). Empty = ranked by price per kWh.
data_description.price_limit: Optional, in €/kWh. The “Cheap now” binary sensor is on while the cheapest price is at or below this. Empty = on while it will not get cheaper within the next 24 hours.
data_description.operators: Optional, comma-separated, e.g. "Tesla" or "EnBW, Ionity". Empty = all.
data_description.operators_entity: Optional: Also reads the charging networks from the “operators” attribute of an entity, e.g. sensor.ladecockpit_multipass (networks where MultiPass has worked). The list then grows by itself. Only stations of these networks count.
data_description.location_entity: Optional: the search moves with this entity, e.g. your car (device_tracker) or a person. Without a current position the location above is used. The radius always comes from the search area.

error.radius_too_large: The radius must not exceed 50 km.
error.radius_too_small: The radius must be at least 500 m.
